title: Pool Helmsman micro-panel: lightweight GPU-pool heuristics & burst choreography
creator: Marisol Gomez
description: Purpose: Design a compact, contextual control panel that surfaces real-time pool health heuristics and lets operators trigger, preview, and schedule short-lived burst policies without leaving the console route. The Pool Helmsman micro-panel is intended for on-the-fly triage and rapid policy adjustments when an operator detects capacity pressure or latency spikes. Goals: 1) Make critical signals and control actions available in a single compact surface adjacent to pool detail pages and per-route views. 2) Provide a safe preview mode showing expected impact (cost delta, latency tradeoffs, affected models/routes) before committing. 3) Support ephemeral bursts (1–30 mins), scheduled bursts, and quick rollbacks. 4) Surface confidence and provenance for suggested heuristics (why we recommend a burst — e.g., queue depth, hot-route %). Out of scope: full autoscale policy editor and long-term capacity planning flows (those live in Dedicated Capacity Settings).
acceptance_criteria: Micro-panel renders in pool detail header and per-route inspector without layout regressions
Operators can trigger an ephemeral burst with a single confirm action and optional duration presets (5m, 15m, 30m)
Preview shows estimated token-cost delta and latency improvement band for the selected duration
Panel logs actions to audit trail and surfaces links to the rollout that performed the change
Design passes accessibility review (color contrast, keyboard focus, screen-reader labels)
